conditions.catalog_anchor: ARC-0097 / REL-0003 / CC-0015: stop condition 13, spec 11390, 'release/canary succeeds'
conditions.evidence: Owner decision OQ-3 binds release mode to PR-ONLY: propose changes as pull requests, never a private canary and never a public marketplace release. Condition 13 as written ('release/canary succeeds', spec 11390) has no referent under that mode — there is no canary channel and no marketplace release that can succeed — so the as-written predicate is NOT-APPLICABLE, not TRUE (a silent pass) and not FALSE (a permanent block). This N/A is mode-conditional, not permanent: REL-0003 rejects marking 13 permanently N/A, and under PRIVATE-CANARY or PUBLIC-MARKETPLACE the same condition is REQUIRED. OQ-9 / REL-0003 (merged PR plus REL-0004/REL-0005/REL-0006 rehearsal) is a different predicate and is not scored as a silent TRUE here.

This N/A is mode-conditional, not permanent: REL-0003 rejects marking 13 permanently N/A, and under PRIVATE-CANARY or PUBLIC-MARKETPLACE the same condition is REQUIRED.
